topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I can't believe they would even suggest this. I've spent countless hours on my yard, making it a place of peace and beauty, and now they want to turn a chunk of it into some makeshift garden? Just because we're neighbors, does that give them the right to assume I’ll just agree to whatever they want? I've been polite, always trying to be a good neighbor, but this is crossing a line. They must think I don't care about the look of my property. As if I have nothing better to do than tend to their plants. This is my space, and I will decide what happens to it.
